decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program extends the firm's established mental-health services, was prominently presented, and still fits an expanding care provider with specialist expertise.
The carpentry workshop remains plausible because it supports the firm's therapeutic and sheltered-work model, though its custom-furniture business is still more peripheral than core care services.
Outpatient sociotherapy is closely aligned with the firm's person-centered community support offer and is therefore likely to remain in the portfolio.
Counseling for senior living is highly consistent with the eldercare business and its strong website prominence suggests it has ongoing strategic importance.
The retail shop supports inclusion and sales from sheltered-work activities, but as a more commercially exposed downstream format it still carries comparatively higher discontinuation risk.

Meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's eldercare and outpatient support logic, but its newer launch status and operational intensity make it somewhat less secure than the most established care offerings.
